column2: Well now... is it finally the star of the show?
$$正義$$ without power is powerless, and power without $$正義$$ is tyranny.
My name is $$ミカエル$$, the most evil $$大天使$$!!
It seems that from the very beginning, you and I were fated...
to bear the destiny of fighting one another.
But just because you defeated the others...
do not underestimate the $$生命力$$ of us $$大天使$$s!?
As one praised as Heaven's representative warrior angel...
the power of the $$正義$$ I believe in...
Hey... did you realize I rather liked $$ルピルピ$$...?
she wrote, "I wish we could meet first next time."
